messages.subject: Garrety grievance - need urgent advice
messages.plaintextBody:
Tom,

Further to our call, David Garrety (our Group HR & Operations Director) has put in a formal grievance dated 6 February. He's alleging whistleblowing detriment over the Dudley testing records and the year-end provisions, and he's hinting at age discrimination because of the restructuring. He has Birchall Stone advising him.

We need to get on the front foot. Can you take this on and send terms?

Richard Pennington
Chief Executive, Pennington Industries Limited

messages.subject: RE: Garrety grievance - need urgent advice
messages.plaintextBody:
Richard,

Yes, we can act. I attach our engagement letter (our ref WC-00155). I'll have an advice note to you early next week setting out the merits and a recommended settlement strategy. In the meantime please preserve all documents relating to the November/December reports and the restructuring decision - do not delete anything.

Elena Marchetti will assist me; Sarah Whitfield is supervising.

Kind regards,
Tom Gallagher
Associate | Employment & Disputes
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
T +44 (0)20 7946 0834
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
